content: Converging community guidance for Go plus SQLite: WAL allows concurrent readers but not concurrent writers; configure pragmas via DSN so every pooled connection gets them; the portable contention fix is a single-connection writer pool (SetMaxOpenConns(1), SetMaxIdleConns(1)) plus _txlock=immediate, which turns writer contention into goroutines waiting on the pool mutex instead of SQLITE_BUSY errors. Some applications split two pools (bounded reader pool plus single-connection writer pool) to preserve read concurrency, at the cost of two handles. modernc own docs recommend bounding the pool because each connection carries its own page cache and libc state. For a small utility cache the simplest correct configuration is one pool with MaxOpenConns(1); WAL still pays off across processes, where other processes can read while this one writes.
